column8: ["The broad ivory slab reads as a backing plate beneath the sockets, plainly violating the no-plate rule despite its solid presence.","The repeated rust-red and grey collars feel diagrammatic; brass lacks rubbed metallic depth, rubber lacks a distinct matte character, and the ceramic glaze looks chalky.","Brown speckling drifts across the ivory surface instead of gathering at contact edges, making the body look uniformly dirty rather than purposefully worn.","Bright upper-left rims and dark lower-right edging imply directional lighting that would rotate with the sprite."]

["The broad ivory field reads as a backing plate beneath the seats, plainly violating the no-plate rule.","The body looks chalky and the rings rusty orange; ceramic glaze, rubbed dark brass and matte rubber lack distinct material character.","Identical thin collars and largely blank ivory expanses make the object feel like a stamped diagram. Stronger sculpting and purposeful contact-edge wear would give it a maker's character."]

["The broad ivory field reads as a backing plate beneath the seats, dominating the object despite the explicit prohibition on a plate or base.","Materials are thinly differentiated: the ivory looks chalky, while the red and blue-green collars lack convincing glazed ceramic, rubbed brass or matte rubber character.","Identical softly outlined collars and largely blank ivory make the machine feel like a painted diagram. More decisive material transitions and purposeful contact-edge wear would give it a maker's character."]
